::: {.manual-status}
**Resource status:** Usable beta. Adapt it to the method and check local requirements. Do not place confidential or identifiable information in a public copy.
:::

## When to use it

Use this at the pause point before you commit, submit, collect, change, close or escalate the relevant work. Tick an item only when you can identify the evidence.

## Checklist

- [ ] I can state the purpose and the decision this check supports.
- [ ] I have identified the applicable local, disciplinary or project requirements.
- [ ] I have separated verified facts from assumptions and unresolved questions.
- [ ] I have checked the most consequential risks, dependencies and failure modes.
- [ ] I have recorded the evidence, owner and date for each material judgement.
- [ ] I know what is good enough for this stage and what remains deliberately unfinished.
- [ ] I know the condition that would make me pause or escalate.
- [ ] I have named the next action and what will count as done.

## Completed example

**Purpose:** decide whether the next project step is ready to proceed.  
**Evidence checked:** current project record, relevant official requirement and the latest approved plan.  
**Unresolved point:** one dependency remains with an external owner.  
**Decision:** proceed only with reversible preparation; do not begin the dependent activity.  
**Next review:** at the agreed response date.  
**Escalation:** raise the matter if the dependency affects safety, approval, integrity or the milestone.

## What this prevents

This resource reduces decisions being lost, assumptions being mistaken for facts, and actions being marked complete without evidence.
